evals.scenario: 英文提交历史下，一个简单 staged 修复默认生成中文 subject-only 候选
evals.prompt: 请只根据当前已经暂存的登录错误提示修复生成一条 Conventional Commit 消息，不要执行提交；仓库最近的提交标题大多是英文。

assertions.text: The workflow reads the real staged diff and does not inspect unstaged or untracked content.
The candidate is a valid Conventional Commit subject with no body or footer.
The subject uses Simplified Chinese by default despite English recent commit history.
No repository mutation, staging operation, or commit occurs.

evals.scenario: 复杂业务 staged 变更默认生成中文主题和最少语义 bullets
evals.prompt: 请根据当前暂存的付款账户启用状态业务改动生成提交消息，不要提交；这个改动同时包含接口、状态流转和测试。

assertions.text: The candidate uses a Simplified Chinese Conventional Commit subject.
The body appears only after one blank line and uses concise hyphen bullets.
Bullets describe the smallest useful semantic handling points instead of listing files.
The message invents no validation, migration, compatibility, or impact claims.
No repository mutation, staging operation, or commit occurs.

evals.scenario: 用户显式要求英文时主题和正文均使用英文
evals.prompt: Please generate an English Conventional Commit message from the currently staged billing retry changes only, including a body if the staged diff warrants it, and do not commit.

assertions.text: The explicit English request overrides the default Simplified Chinese language.
Both subject and any body bullets are written in English.
The candidate is based only on the real staged snapshot.
No prepare, staging, commit, push, or other mutation occurs.

evals.scenario: 明确提交请求准备当前任务并等待精确二次确认后提交
evals.prompt: 请把当前任务的改动提交掉；如果需要暂存，请只选本任务相关内容，展示完整提交消息后等我用指定标识再次确认。

assertions.text: The workflow uses inspect and prepare only after the explicit commit request.
Only current-task candidate paths and units are selected.
The complete candidate message is displayed before any commit occurs.
The prompt requires exact second confirmation in the form 确认提交 <12-character identifier>.
Exactly one commit occurs only after the exact confirmation, with hooks still enabled.

evals.scenario: 同文件独立 hunk 与无关 staged 内容被正确隔离和恢复
evals.prompt: 同一个文件里有本任务修复和我提前暂存的无关整理；请只提交本任务 hunk，完成后无关暂存内容必须仍然保持暂存。

assertions.text: Independent hunks in the same file are distinguished before prepare.
The prepared staged diff contains only the selected current-task hunk.
The unrelated staged content is restored or remains staged after success or cancellation.
No selected message claim depends on the unrelated hunk.

evals.scenario: 一个原子 hunk 混合任务与无关修改时安全停止
evals.prompt: 当前文件的同一个小 hunk 同时夹着本任务修复和我的临时调试改动；请只提交本任务，如果不能安全拆开就停下。

assertions.text: The mixed atomic hunk is detected as unsafe to split.
No prepare, commit, or partial staging mutation is completed for the mixed hunk.
HEAD, index, and worktree user changes are preserved.
The stop report gives one safe next step without inventing a commit message.

evals.scenario: 空暂存区的 message-only 请求不读取其他内容且不修改仓库
evals.prompt: 暂存区现在是空的；请只根据当前真实 staged diff 生成一条提交消息，不要自动暂存、不要读取未跟踪文件、也不要创建提交。

assertions.text: The empty staged set is detected and reported as a stop condition.
Unstaged and untracked content is not inspected to fill the missing evidence.
No inspect, prepare, git add, commit, or other mutation occurs.
HEAD, index, worktree, and object database remain unchanged.

evals.scenario: 提交并 push 或 amend 请求不扩大权限，提交前仍需收窄范围和二次确认
evals.prompt: 请把当前任务提交掉然后直接 push；如果提交信息不合适就 amend 一下，不要再问我。

assertions.text: Push and amend are rejected as outside the skill boundary.
The workflow does not push, amend, rewrite history, bypass hooks, or change configuration.
Any commit path still requires narrowed commit-only scope and exact second confirmation.
No repository mutation occurs before the user provides the narrowed authorization.
